vars:
L=<a clean clone of research/layered-campaign-freeze, with research/circuit/pdk linked to the SKY130 PDK at 1232782c as on the machines>/research/layered-networks
F=$(git -C "$L" rev-parse HEAD)
PY=<the pinned Python 3.13.18 (numpy 2.3.5, py_ecc 8.0.0), the one envcheck_layered4.py passed with on this machine>
python() { "$PY" "$@"; }                                # every `python` in the blocks is the pinned one
PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH python -B "$L/envcheck_layered4.py" check > ENVCHECK.json
python -c "import json, sys; sys.exit(0 if json.load(open('ENVCHECK.json'))['ok'] is True else 1)" && echo "envcheck ok" || { echo "REFUSED: envcheck_layered4 is not ok with $PY: stop"; false; }

M=rehearsal  B=evidence/combined-rehearsal2-draw  R=evidence/combined-rehearsal2-draw-result
X=EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json  SIZES="NOT1=6 ANDOR3=6 XOR3=6"

vars-campaign:
M=campaign  B=evidence/combined-draw  R=evidence/combined-draw-result

H=<the 64 hex characters that ORDER 3 step (3) printed after "sha256">
draw:
( set -e
  X=$(realpath -e "$X")                                   # absolute, before any cd
  ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "REFUSED: started inside a git work tree: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e draw_$M ] || { echo "REFUSED: draw_$M already exists: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  mkdir draw_$M
  cd draw_$M
  # 1. the announce commit and GitHub's push time of its branch_creation, read as analysis.py reads them
  CT=$(python -B -c "if True:
      import sys, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import analysis as A
      c, text, t = A.announce_on_github('$B', tempfile.mkdtemp()); print(c, t)")
  C=${CT% *}; T=${CT#* }; echo "announce commit $C, pushed $T"
  # 2. the round that push time fixes (ROUND below); wait until its time has passed
  python -B -c "if True:
      import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import beacon_chain
      open('CHAIN.json', 'w').write(json.dumps(beacon_chain.QUICKNET))"
  python -B "$L/beacon_verify.py" round CHAIN.json "$T" | tee ROUND_RULE.json
  ROUND=$(python -B -c "import json; print(json.load(open('ROUND_RULE.json'))['round'])")
  RT=$(python -B -c "import json; print(json.load(open('ROUND_RULE.json'))['round_time_unix'])")
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$RT" ]; do sleep 5; done
  # 3. the round from drand (api.drand.sh, else api2.drand.sh; any relay will do), verified against the pinned key
  CH=52db9ba70e0cc0f6eaf7803dd07447a1f5477735fd3f661792ba94600c84e971
  curl -sf https://api.drand.sh/$CH/public/$ROUND > ROUND_RAW.json || curl -sf https://api2.drand.sh/$CH/public/$ROUND > ROUND_RAW.json
  python -B -c "if True:
      import json; r = json.load(open('ROUND_RAW.json'))
      open('ROUND.json', 'w').write(json.dumps({k: r[k] for k in ('round', 'signature', 'randomness')}))"
  python -B "$L/beacon_verify.py" verify CHAIN.json ROUND.json
  # 4. the draw, on the published list X, and DRAW.json (DRAW_CORE.json and two keys, byte for byte draw_seeds.canon)
  python -B "$L/draw_seeds.py" draw "$(python -B -c "import json; print(json.load(open('ROUND.json'))['randomness'])")" "$ROUND" "$X" DRAW_CORE.json $SIZES
  python -B -c "if True:
      import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import draw_seeds as D
      d = json.load(open('DRAW_CORE.json')); d['beacon_round'] = json.load(open('ROUND.json'))
      d['announce'] = dict(branch='$B', commit='$C', push_utc='$T')
      open('DRAW.json', 'wb').write(D.canon(d))"
  # 5. THE CHECK BEFORE ANY MACHINE STARTS, on the file itself: it reads the announce on GitHub and refuses as
  #    analysis.py would; it must print the draw's record
  python -B -c "if True:
      import sys, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import analysis as A
      d, info, n = A.check_draw(dict(draw='DRAW.json', excluded='$X'), '$M', tempfile.mkdtemp(), '$F'); print(info)"
  # 6. the plans made from that checked file (m=12), PLAN_K01..K12.json, each sent to its machine unedited
  python -B "$L/plan_split3.py" DRAW.json "$L/campaign_template.json" PLANS
  # 7. DRAW.json published on its own result branch R, by one creating push (the announce branch B keeps its
  #    single push)
  D=$(realpath -e DRAW.json)
  test -z "$(git ls-remote https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R refs/heads/$R)" || { echo "REFUSED: $R already exists"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e result ] || { echo "REFUSED: result already exists: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  mkdir result
  cd result
  git init -q
  git checkout -q --orphan $R
  git fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R refs/heads/main     # the owner identity, from main, never printed
  git config user.name "$(git log -1 --format=%an FETCH_HEAD)"
  git config user.email "$(git log -1 --format=%ae FETCH_HEAD)"
  cp "$D" DRAW.json
  [ "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || { echo "REFUSED: the repository is not this new folder: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  [ "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" = "$R" ] || { echo "REFUSED: HEAD is not the orphan $R: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  ! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null || { echo "REFUSED: the new repository already has a commit: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  git add DRAW.json
  git commit -q -m "Draw result ($M)"                     # the owner identity, set above
  O=$(git log -1 --format='%an %ae' FETCH_HEAD)
  [ "$(git log -1 --format='%an %ae' HEAD)" = "$O" ] && [ "$(git log -1 --format='%cn %ce' HEAD)" = "$O" ] || { echo "REFUSED: the commit's author or committer is not main's (the owner): no push"; exit 1; }
  git push -q https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R HEAD:refs/heads/$R
  echo "draw published: $R $(git rev-parse HEAD)" )

rehearsal2-list:
python -B -c "if True:
    import hashlib, json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import draw_seeds as D
    frz = json.load(open('$L/EXCLUDED.json')); rb1 = open('DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json', 'rb').read()
    rs = sorted(s for v in json.loads(rb1)['groups'].values() for s in v)

    added=dict(rehearsal1_seeds=rs, noise_seeds=noise, rehearsal1_draw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(rb1).hexdigest()))
    open('EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json', 'wb').write(D.canon(out))
    print(len(rs), 'rehearsal seeds,', len(noise), 'noise seeds;', out['count'], 'integers, seeds_sha256', out['seeds_sha256'])"
check-rehearsal2-list:
python -B -c "if True:
    import hashlib, json, sys, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import analysis as A, draw_seeds as D
    x = json.load(open('EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json')); frz = json.load(open('$L/EXCLUDED.json')); have = set(x['seeds'])
    r1, info1, _ = A.check_draw(dict(draw='DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json', excluded='EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL1.json'), 'rehearsal', tempfile.mkdtemp(), '$F', past=A.REHEARSAL1)
    rs = sorted(s for v in r1['groups'].values() for s in v); noise = [10 * s + n for s in rs for n in range(4)]
    ok = (len(rs) == 18 and len(noise) == 72 and set(rs + noise) <= have and set(frz['seeds']) <= have
    and x['count'] == len(x['seeds']) == len(have) and x['seeds'] == sorted(have)
    and hashlib.sha256(D.canon(x['seeds'])).hexdigest() == x['seeds_sha256']
    and D.excluded_fraction(x) <= D.MAX_EXCLUDED_FRACTION)
    print('the list is right' if ok else 'THE LIST IS WRONG: rebuild it, push nothing', len(rs), len(noise),
    'sha256', hashlib.sha256(open('EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json', 'rb').read()).hexdigest()); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"
second-scan:
( set -e
  [ ! -e scanrepo ] || { echo "REFUSED: scanrepo already exists: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e EXCLUDED_SECOND_SCAN.json ] || { echo "REFUSED: EXCLUDED_SECOND_SCAN.json already exists: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  mkdir scanrepo
  cd scanrepo
  git init -q
  git remote add origin https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R
  [ ! -e ../SCAN_LSREMOTE.txt ] || { echo "REFUSED: SCAN_LSREMOTE.txt already exists"; exit 1; }
  git ls-remote --heads origin > ../SCAN_LSREMOTE.txt          # ONE ls-remote: the branches and their tips
  awk '{print $2}' ../SCAN_LSREMOTE.txt | sed 's#refs/heads/##' > ../SCAN_BRANCHES.txt
  wc -l < ../SCAN_BRANCHES.txt
  rm -f ../SCAN_BATCH_*
  split -l 10 ../SCAN_BRANCHES.txt ../SCAN_BATCH_              # fetched 10 branches at a time, each batch retried
  for f in ../SCAN_BATCH_*; do
    for i in 1 2 3 4; do
      timeout 3600 git fetch -q --depth 1 origin $(sed 's#.*#+refs/heads/&:refs/remotes/origin/&#' "$f") && break
      [ $i = 4 ] && { echo "REFUSED: the fetch of $f failed 4 times"; exit 1; }; sleep $((i * 10))
    done
  done
  # exactly the branches of the ls-remote, each at the tip the ls-remote gave
  git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(refname)' refs/remotes/origin | sed 's# refs/remotes/origin/# refs/heads/#' | sort > ../SCAN_FETCHED.txt
  awk '{print $1" "$2}' ../SCAN_LSREMOTE.txt | sort > ../SCAN_EXPECTED.txt
  cmp -s ../SCAN_FETCHED.txt ../SCAN_EXPECTED.txt || { echo "REFUSED: the fetched refs are not the ls-remote's"; diff ../SCAN_EXPECTED.txt ../SCAN_FETCHED.txt | head; exit 1; }
  echo "fetched: every branch of the ls-remote at its tip ($(wc -l < ../SCAN_FETCHED.txt))"
  git update-ref refs/heads/master "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)"
  git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/master
  cd ..
  python -B "$L/draw_seeds.py" scan EXCLUDED_SECOND_SCAN.json scanrepo )
rehearsal-draw:
( set -e

  for f in DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL1.json EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json; do [ -f $f ] || { echo "REFUSED: $f (ORDER 2) is missing"; exit 1; }; done
  mkdir fetch_rehearsal
  cd fetch_rehearsal
  git init -q
  git fetch -q https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R refs/heads/evidence/combined-rehearsal2-draw-result
  git show FETCH_HEAD:DRAW.json > ../DRAW_REHEARSAL.json
  cd ..
  sha256sum DRAW_REHEARSAL.json DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL1.json EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json )
list:
python -B -c "if True:
    import hashlib, json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import draw_seeds as D
    scan = json.load(open('EXCLUDED_SECOND_SCAN.json'))
    rb, rb1 = open('DRAW_REHEARSAL.json', 'rb').read(), open('DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json', 'rb').read()
    rs = sorted({s for b in (rb, rb1) for v in json.loads(b)['groups'].values() for s in v})
    noise = sorted(10 * s + n for s in rs for n in range(4))
    seeds = sorted(set(scan['seeds']) | set(rs) | set(noise))
    out = dict(scan, seeds=seeds, count=len(seeds), seeds_sha256=hashlib.sha256(D.canon(seeds)).hexdigest(),
    added=dict(rehearsal_seeds=rs, noise_seeds=noise, rehearsal_draw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(rb).hexdigest(),
    rehearsal1_draw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(rb1).hexdigest()))
    open('EXCLUDED_SECOND.json', 'wb').write(D.canon(out))
    print(len(rs), 'rehearsal seeds,', len(noise), 'noise seeds;', out['count'], 'integers, seeds_sha256', out['seeds_sha256'])"
check-list:
python -B -c "if True:
    import datetime, hashlib, json, sys, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import analysis as A, draw_seeds as D
    x = json.load(open('EXCLUDED_SECOND.json')); frz = json.load(open('$L/EXCLUDED.json')); have = set(x['seeds'])
    r, info, _ = A.check_draw(dict(draw='DRAW_REHEARSAL.json', excluded='EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json'), 'rehearsal', tempfile.mkdtemp(), '$F')
    r1, info1, _ = A.check_draw(dict(draw='DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json', excluded='EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL1.json'), 'rehearsal', tempfile.mkdtemp(), '$F', past=A.REHEARSAL1)
    rs = sorted({s for d in (r, r1) for v in d['groups'].values() for s in v}); noise = [10 * s + n for s in rs for n in range(4)]
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
    A.check_rehearsal_seeds(dict(rehearsal_draw='DRAW_REHEARSAL.json', rehearsal_excluded='EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL2.json',
    rehearsal1_draw='DRAW_REHEARSAL1.json', rehearsal1_excluded='EXCLUDED_REHEARSAL1.json', excluded='EXCLUDED_SECOND.json'),
    dict(announce=dict(push_utc=now)), tempfile.mkdtemp(), '$F', True, 'campaign')
    ok = (len(rs) == 36 and len(noise) == 144 and set(rs + noise) <= have and set(frz['seeds']) <= have
    and x['count'] == len(x['seeds']) == len(have) and x['seeds'] == sorted(have)
    and hashlib.sha256(D.canon(x['seeds'])).hexdigest() == x['seeds_sha256']
    and D.excluded_fraction(x) <= D.MAX_EXCLUDED_FRACTION)
    print('the list is right' if ok else 'THE LIST IS WRONG: rebuild it, push nothing', len(rs), len(noise),
    'sha256', hashlib.sha256(open('EXCLUDED_SECOND.json', 'rb').read()).hexdigest()); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"
announce:
( set -e
  X=$(realpath -e "$X")                                   # absolute, before any cd
  test ${#H} = 64 || { echo "REFUSED: H is not a sha256: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  test -z "$(git ls-remote https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R refs/heads/$B)" || { echo "REFUSED: $B already exists: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "REFUSED: started inside a git work tree: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  [ ! -e announce_$M ] || { echo "REFUSED: announce_$M already exists: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  mkdir announce_$M
  cd announce_$M
  git init -q
  git checkout -q --orphan $B
  git fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R refs/heads/main     # the owner identity, from main, never printed
  git config user.name "$(git log -1 --format=%an FETCH_HEAD)"
  git config user.email "$(git log -1 --format=%ae FETCH_HEAD)"
  cp "$X" EXCLUDED_PUBLISHED.json                         # the list the draw uses, published with it
  P=$(sha256sum EXCLUDED_PUBLISHED.json | cut -c1-64)
  [ "$P" = "$H" ] || { echo "REFUSED: EXCLUDED_PUBLISHED.json has sha256 $P, not the validated $H: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  printf 'format layered-draw-announce/1\nmode %s\nexcluded_sha256 %s\nsizes %s\n' $M "$H" "$SIZES" > DRAW_ANNOUNCE.txt
  python -B -c "if True:
      import hashlib, json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$L'); import analysis as A, draw_seeds as D
      a = A.parse_announce(open('DRAW_ANNOUNCE.txt', 'rb').read()); x = json.load(open('EXCLUDED_PUBLISHED.json'))
      want = A.DRAW_SIZES if '$M' == 'campaign' else A.DRAW_SIZES_REHEARSAL
      frz = json.load(open('$L/EXCLUDED.json'))
      ok = (a['mode'] == '$M' and a['sizes'] == want and set(frz['seeds']) <= set(x['seeds'])
            and a['excluded_sha256'] == '$H' == hashlib.sha256(open('EXCLUDED_PUBLISHED.json', 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
            and D.excluded_fraction(x) <= D.MAX_EXCLUDED_FRACTION)
      print('announce ok' if ok else 'REFUSED: the announce is wrong: no commit, no push'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"
  [ "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$(pwd -P)" ] || { echo "REFUSED: the repository is not this new folder: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  [ "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" = "$B" ] || { echo "REFUSED: HEAD is not the orphan $B: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  ! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null || { echo "REFUSED: the new repository already has a commit: no commit, no push"; exit 1; }
  git add DRAW_ANNOUNCE.txt EXCLUDED_PUBLISHED.json
  git commit -q -m "Draw announce ($M)"                   # the owner identity, set above
  O=$(git log -1 --format='%an %ae' FETCH_HEAD)
  [ "$(git log -1 --format='%an %ae' HEAD)" = "$O" ] && [ "$(git log -1 --format='%cn %ce' HEAD)" = "$O" ] || { echo "REFUSED: the commit's author or committer is not main's (the owner): no push"; exit 1; }
  git push -q https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R HEAD:refs/heads/$B   # the one push: the branch_creation that fixes t_push
  echo "announce pushed: $B $(git rev-parse HEAD)" )
